G3854.def:
**παρα-γίνομαι**
(Ion. and late for -γίγν-), [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
1. to be beside or at hand (Hom., Hdt., al.), hence, to stand by, sup­port (Æsch., Thuc., al.) : with dative of person(s), [[2Ti.4.16|2Ti.4:16]]
2. **to come, come up, arrive **(Hdt., Xen., al., and frequently in later writers; see MM, xviii; Thackeray, _Gr._, 267.2): absol., [[Luk.14.21; 19.16|Luk.14:21 19:16]], [[Jhn.3.23|Jhn.3:23]], [[Act.5.21-22, 25; 9.39; 10.32-33; 11.23; 14.27; 17.10; 18.27; 21.18; 23.16, 35; 24.17, 24; 25.7; 28.21|Act.5:21-22, 25 9:39 10:32-33 11:23 14:27 17:10 18:27 21:18 23:16, 35 24:17, 24 25:7 28:21]], [[1Co.16.3|1Co.16:3]]; before εἰς, [[Jhn.8.2|Jhn.8:2]], [[Act.9.26; 15.4|Act.9:26 15:4]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[Luk.22.52|Luk.22:52]] πρός, with accusative, [[Luk.7.4, 20; 8.19|Luk.7:4, 20 8:19]], [[Act.20.18|Act.20:18]]; id. before ἐκ, [[Luk.11.6|Luk.11:6]] παρά, with genitive, [[Mrk.14.43|Mrk.14:43]] ἀπὸ . . . εἰς, [[Mat.2.1|Mat.2:1]], [[Act.13.14|Act.13:14]]; ἀπὸ . . . ἐπὶ . . . πρός, [[Mat.3.13|Mat.3:13]] of a teacher coming forward in public: [[Mat.3.1|Mat.3:1]], [[Luk.12.51|Luk.12:51]], [[Heb.9.11|Heb.9:11]].†
(AS)

G3844.def:
**παρά**, _prep._ with genitive, dative, accusative,
with radical sense, **beside**.
I. C. genitive of person(s), **from the side of, from beside, from**, indicating source or origin, [in LXX for מֵאֵצֶל ,מִיַד ,מִלִּפְנֵי ;] after verbs of motion, [[Mrk.14.43|Mrk.14:43]], [[Luk.8.49|Luk.8:49]], [[Jhn.15.26|Jhn.15:26]], al.; after verbs of seeking, receiving, hearing, etc., [[Mrk.8.11; 12.2|Mrk.8:11 12:2]], [[Jhn.4.9, 52; 10.18|Jhn.4:9, 52 10:18]], [[Php.4.18|Php.4:18]], [[2Ti.1.18|2Ti.1:18]], [[Jas.1.7|Jas.1:7]], al.; after passive verbs, of the agent (like ὑπό), [[Mat.21.42|Mat.21:42]], [[Mrk.12.11|Mrk.12:11]], [[Luk.1.37|Luk.1:37]]; absol., οἱ παρ᾽ αὐτοῦ, _his family, his kinsfolk_, [[Mrk.3.21|Mrk.3:21]] (cf. M, _Pr._, 106f.; Field, _Notes_, 25f.; Swete, in l.); τὰ παρ᾽ αὐτῆς (αὐτῶν, ὑμῶν, _one's means, wealth_, [[Mrk.5.26|Mrk.5:26]], [[Luk.10.7|Luk.10:7]], [[Php.4.18|Php.4:18]].
II. C. dative of person(s) (exc. [[Jhn.19.25|Jhn.19:25]], π. τ. σταυρῷ), **by the side of, beside, by, with**, [in LXX for בְּעֵינֵי ,בְּיַד ,אֵצֶל ;] [[Luk.11.37; 19.7|Luk.11:37 19:7]], [[Jhn.1.40; 4.40|Jhn.1:40 4:40]], [[Act.28.14|Act.28:14]], al.; παρ᾽ ἑαυτῷ, _at home_, [[1Co.16.2|1Co.16:2]] with dative pl., **among**, [[Mat.22.25|Mat.22:25]], [[Col.4.16|Col.4:16]], al.; metaphorically, [[Mat.19.26|Mat.19:26]], [[Mrk.10.27|Mrk.10:27]], [[Luk.1.30|Luk.1:30]], [[Rom.2.13|Rom.2:13]], [[Jas.1.27|Jas.1:27]], al.
III. C. accusative, of motion by or towards, [in LXX for בְּעֵבֶר ,עַל יַד ,אֵצֶל ;]
1. of place, **by the side of, beside, by, along**: [[Act.10.32|Act.10:32]], [[Heb.11.12|Heb.11:12]]; after verbs of motion, [[Mat.4.18|Mat.4:18]], [[Mrk.4.4|Mrk.4:4]], [[Luk.8.5|Luk.8:5]], [[Act.4.35|Act.4:35]], al.; after verbs of rest, [[Mat.13.1|Mat.13:1]], [[Mrk.5.21|Mrk.5:21]], [[Luk.8.35|Luk.8:35]], al.
2. **beside, beyond**, metaphorically;
(a) **beyond, against, contrary to**: [[Act.18.13|Act.18:13]], [[Rom.1.26; 4.18; 11.24|Rom.1:26 4:18 11:24]], al.; except, [[2Co.11.24|2Co.11:24]]
(b) **beyond, above, in comparison with**: [[Luk.3.13|Luk.3:13]], [[Rom.12.3; 14.5|Rom.12:3 14:5]], [[Heb.1.4, 9; 3.3|Heb.1:4, 9 3:3]], al.;
(with) **on account of**: [[1Co.12.15, 16|1Co.12:15, 16]].
IV. **In composition**: **beside, to** (παραλαμβάνω, παράγω), **at hand** (πάρειμι), **from** (παραρρέω), **amiss** (παρακούω), **past** (παρέρχομαι), **compared with** (παρομοιάζω), **above measure** (παροργίζω).
(AS)

G3816.def:
**παῖς**, genitive, παιδός, ὁ, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for עֶבֶד, also for נַעַר, נַעֲרָה, etc. ;]
1. **a child, boy, youth, maiden**: ὁ π., [[Mat.17.18|Mat.17:18]], [[Luk.2.43; 9.42|Luk.2:43 9:42]], [[Act.20.12|Act.20:12]]; ἡ π. [[Luk.8.51, 54|Luk.8:51, 54]] (on the artic. fern, of address, see M, _Pr._, 70 f., 235; B1., § 33, 4); pl., [[Mat.2.16; 21.15|Mat.2:16 21:15]]; of parentage, with genitive, [[Jhn.4.51|Jhn.4:51]]
2. Like _Heb._ עֶבֶד, Lat. Auer, Fr. garcon, Eng. boy (Æsch., Aristoph., Xen., al.), **servant, slave, attendant**: [[Mat.8.6, 8; 8.13|Mat.8:6, 8 8:13]] [[Luk.7.7; 12.45; 15.26|Luk.7:7 12:45 15:26]]; in late writers (Diod., LXX: [[Gen.41.37|Gen.41:37]], al.), of a king's attendant or minister : [[Mat.14.2|Mat.14:2]] so (= _Heb._ יְהוָֹה עֶבֶד) π. τ. θεοῦ ([[Psa.69.18|Psa.69:18]], [[Isa.41.8|Isa.41:8]], [[Wis.2.13|Wis.2:13]], al.), of Israel, [[Luk.1.54|Luk.1:54]] of David, [[Luk.1.69|Luk.1:69]], [[Act.4.25|Act.4:25]]; of Jesus (but see Dalman, _Words_, 277 f.), [[Mat.12.18|Mat.12:18]] (LXX), [[Act.3.13, 26; 4.27, 30|Act.3:13, 26 4:27, 30]].†
_SYN._:
1. τέκνον, **child**, with emphasis on parentage and the consequent community of nature; υἱός, son, with emphasis on the privileged position of heirship; π. refers both to age and parentage, but with emphasis on the former. Cf. also (παιδάριον), (παιδίον), (παιδίσκη), and see Westc. on [[1Jn.3.1|1Jn.3:1]]
2. see: θεράπων, and cf. Thackeray, _Gr._, 7 f
(AS)

G3870.def:
**παρακαλέω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for נחם ni., pi. ;]
1. **to call to** one, **call for, summon**: [[Act.28.20|Act.28:20]] (R, mg.; R, txt., **entreat**); hence (of the gods: Dem., Xen., al.), **to invoke, call on, beseech, entreat**: τ. πατέρα μου, [[Mat.26.53|Mat.26:53]] τ. κύριον, [[2Co.12.8|2Co.12:8]] in late writers (Polyb., Diod., al.; rarely in LXX; in π., see Deiss., _LAE_, 176.14), also of men: absol., Phm 9; with accusative, [[Mat.8.5|Mat.8:5]], [[Mrk.1.40|Mrk.1:40]], [[Act.16.9|Act.16:9]], al.; with inf., [[Mrk.5.17|Mrk.5:17]], [[Luk.8.41|Luk.8:41]], [[Act.8.31|Act.8:31]], al.; before ἵνα (see M, _Pr._, 205, 208), Mt 14"36, [[Mrk.5.18|Mrk.5:18]], [[Luke.8.31|Luk.8:31]], al.
2. **to admonish, exhort**: absol., [[Luk.3.18|Luk.3:18]], [[Rom.12.8|Rom.12:8]], [[2Ti.4.2|2Ti.4:2]], al.; with accusative, [[Act.15.32|Act.15:32]], [[1Th.2.11|1Th.2:11]], [[Heb.3.13|Heb.3:13]], al.; id. before inf., [[Act.11.23|Act.11:23]], [[Rom.12.1|Rom.12:1]], [[Php.4.2|Php.4:2]], [[1Th.4.10|1Th.4:10]], al.; before ἵνα (see M, _Pr._, l.with), [[1Co.1.10|1Co.1:10]], [[2Co.8.6|2Co.8:6]], [[1Th.4.1|1Th.4:1]], al.
3. **to cheer, encourage, comfort** (Plut., LXX: Jb 43, [[Isa.35.3|Isa.35:3]], [[Sir.43.24|Sir.43:24]], al.): with accusative, [[2Co.1.6|2Co.1:6]], [[Eph.6.22|Eph.6:22]], [[Col.2.2|Col.2:2]], al.; id. before ἐν, [[1Th.4.18|1Th.4:18]] διά, [[2Co.1.4|2Co.1:4]] pass., [[Mat.5.4|Mat.5:4]], [[Luk.16.25|Luk.16:25]], [[Act.20.12|Act.20:12]].
_SYN._: παραμυθέω (cf. M, _Th._, 25). (AS)

G3825.def:
**πάλιν**, _adv._,
[in LXX for שׁוּב, etc. ;]
1. of place, **back, backwards** (LS, see word).
2. Of time, **again, once more**: [[Mat.4.8|Mat.4:8]], [[Mrk.2.13|Mrk.2:13]], [[Luk.23.20|Luk.23:20]], [[Jhn.1.35|Jhn.1:35]] (and freq.), [[Act.17.32|Act.17:32]], [[Rom.11.23|Rom.11:23]], [[Gal.1.9|Gal.1:9]], [[Heb.1.6|Heb.1:6]], al; pleonastically, π. ἀνακάμπτειν, [[Act.18.21|Act.18:21]] ὑποστρέφειν, [[Gal.1.17|Gal.1:17]] εἰς τὸ π., [[2Co.13.2|2Co.13:2]] π. ἐκ τρίτου (Bl., §81, 4), [[Mat.26.44|Mat.26:44]] ἐκ δευτέρου, [[Mat.26.42|Mat.26:42]], [[Act.10.15|Act.10:15]]; π. δεῦτερον, [[Jhn.4.54; 21.16|Jhn.4:54 21:16]]; π. ἄνωθεν ( [[Wis.19.6|Wis.19:6]]), [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]].
3. Rhetorically, **again**;
(a) **further, moreover**: [[Mat.5.33|Mat.5:33]], [[Luk.13.20|Luk.13:20]], [[Jhn.12.39|Jhn.12:39]], al.;
(b) **in turn, on the other hand** (Soph.; LXX: [[Wis.13.8; 16.23|Wis.13:8 16:23]], al.): [[Luk.6.43|Luk.6:43]], [[1Co.12.21|1Co.12:21]], [[2Co.10.7|2Co.10:7]], [[1Jn.2.8|1Jn.2:8]].
(AS)

G3860.def:
**παρα-δίδωμι**,
[in LXX chiefly for נתן ;] correl. to παρδέχομαι,
1. **to give** or **hand over** to another: with accusative and dative, [[Mat.11.27; 25.14|Mat.11:27 25:14]], [[Luk.4.6|Luk.4:6]], al.; of being delivered up to a course of teaching, pass. before εἰς, [[Rom.6.17|Rom.6:17]]
2. **to commit, commend**: [[Act.14.26; 15.40|Act.14:26 15:40]], [[1Pe.2.23|1Pe.2:23]].
3. **to give** or **deliver up** to prison or judgment: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.4.12|Mat.4:12]], [[Mrk.1.14|Mrk.1:14]], [[Rom.4.25|Rom.4:25]], [[2Pe.2.4|2Pe.2:4]]; id. before ὑπέρ, [[Rom.8.32|Rom.8:32]] with dative, [[Mat.5.25|Mat.5:25]], [[Mrk.15.1|Mrk.15:1]], [[Luk.12.58|Luk.12:58]], [[Jhn.19.11|Jhn.19:11]], al.; id. before ἵνα, [[Jhn.19.16|Jhn.19:16]] with inf., [[Act.12.4|Act.12:4]] before εἰς, [[Mat.10.17; 17.22; 24.9|Mat.10:17 17:22 24:9]], [[Luk.21.12|Luk.21:12]], [[Act.8.3|Act.8:3]], [[2Co.4.11|2Co.4:11]], al.; τ. Σατανᾷ, [[1Ti.1.20|1Ti.1:20]] id. before εἰς, [[1Co.5.5|1Co.5:5]] with the collat. idea of treachery (= προδίδωμι), with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.26.25|Mat.26:25]], [[Mrk.14.11|Mrk.14:11]], [[Jhn.6.64|Jhn.6:64]], al.; id. with dative, [[Mat.26.15|Mat.26:15]], al.; present ptcp., ὁ παραδιδοὺς, [[Mat.26.25|Mat.26:25]], [[Mrk.14.42|Mrk.14:42]], [[Jhn.13.11|Jhn.13:11]].
4. **to hand down, hand on** or **deliver** verbally (traditions, commands, etc.): [[Mrk.7.13|Mrk.7:13]], [[Luk.1.2|Luk.1:2]], [[Act.6.14|Act.6:14]], [[1Co.11.2; 15.2|1Co.11:2 15:2]]; pass., [[2Pe.2.21|2Pe.2:21]], [[Jude.3|Ju 3]].
5. **to permit** (for exx. in cl., see LS, see word): [[Mrk.4.29|Mrk.4:29]]
(AS)

G3864.def:
**παρα-θαλάσσιος**, -α, -ον
(παρά, θάλασσα) [in LXX: [[Jer.47.7|Jer.47:7]] (יָם חוֹף), etc. ;]
**by the sea**: [[Mat.4.13|Mat.4:13]]†
(AS)

G3855.def:
**παρ-άγω **
[in LXX chiefly for עָבַר ;]
1. trans., to lead by, lead aside, lead into, lead forward, etc.
2. Intrans.,
(a) **to pass by**: [[Mat.9.9, 27; 20.30|Mat.9:9, 27 20:30]], [[Mrk.2.14; 15.21|Mrk.2:14 15:21]], [[Jhn.8.59|Jhn.8:59]] R, txt., [[Jhn.9.1|Jhn.9:1]] before παρό, with accusative, [[Mrk.1.16|Mrk.1:16]]
(b) **to go away, depart**; metaphorically, **to pass away**: [[1Co.7.31|1Co.7:31]] mid., [[1Jn.2.8|1Jn.2:8]] [[Jhn.2.17|Jn 2:17]].†
(AS)

G3820.def:
**παλαιός**, -ά, -όν
(πάλαι), [in LXX: [[Lev.25.22; 26.10|Lev.25:22 26:10]], [[Sng.7.13|Sng.7:13]] (14) (יָשֵׁן), יָשֵׁן), [[Jos.9.4-5|Jos.9:4-5]], [[Jer.38.11|Jer.38:11]] (בָּלֶה), etc. ;]
**old, ancient**; opposite to νέος, καινός: οἶνος, [[Luk.5.3|Luk.5:3]] διαθήκη, [[2Co.3.14|2Co.3:14]] ἐντολή, [[1Jn.2.7|1Jn.2:7]] ζύμη, [[1Co.5.7-8;|1Co.5:7-8]] ὁ π. ἄςθρωπος (for similar phrases, see Westc., _Eph._, 68), [[Rom.6.6|Rom.6:6]], [[Eph.4.22|Eph.4:22]], [[Col.3.9|Col.3:9]]; neut. pl., καινὰ καὶ π., [[Mat.13.52|Mat.13:52]] of things not merely old, but worn by use (as Jo, l.with, LXX), [[Mat.9.16-17|Mat.9:16-17]], [[Mrk.2.21-22|Mrk.2:21-22]], [[Luk.5.36-37|Luk.5:36-37]].†
_SYN._: see: ἀρχαῖος (AS)

G3853.def:
**παρ-αγγέλλω**
(παρά, ἀγγὲλλω), [in LXX for שָׁמַע pi., hi., etc. ;]
1. to transmit a message (Æsch., Eur.).
2. to order, command (Hdt., Xen., al.) : with inf., [[Act.15.5|Act.15:5]] with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.11.17|1Co.11:17]], [[2Th.3.4|2Th.3:4]], [[1Ti.4.11; 5.7|1Ti.4:11 5:7]]; before ἵνα (M, _Pr._, 207; Bl., § 69, 4), [[Mrk.6.8|Mrk.6:8]], [[2Th.3.12|2Th.3:12]]; with dative of person(s), [[Act.17.30|Act.17:30]] R, txt., [[1Th.4.11|1Th.4:11]] before λέγων, [[Mat.10.5|Mat.10:5]] with inf. aor., [[Mat.15.35|Mat.15:35]], [[Mrk.8.6|Mrk.8:6]], [[Luk.8.29|Luk.8:29]], [[Act.10.42; 16.18|Act.10:42 16:18]] (aoristic pres.; see M, _Pr._, 119); id. with neg., μή, [[Luk.5.14; 8.56|Luk.5:14 8:56]], [[Act.23.22|Act.23:22]], [[1Co.7.10|1Co.7:10]]; with inf. pres., [[Act.16.23|Act.16:23]], [[2Th.3.6|2Th.3:6]]; id. with neg., ιή, [[Luk.9.21|Luk.9:21]], [[Act.1.4; 4.18; 5.28, 40|Act.1:4 4:18 5:28, 40]], [[1Ti.1.3; 6.17|1Ti.1:3 6:17]]; with accusative, τοῦτο, before ὅτι (E1., § 70, 3), [[2Th.3.10|2Th.3:10]] with accusative and inf., [[Act.23.30|Act.23:30]], [[2Th.3.6|2Th.3:6]], [[1Ti.6.13|1Ti.6:13]] (Bl., § 72, 5).†
_SYN._: see: ἐντέλλω (AS)

G3819.def:
**πάλαι **
_adv._ of time, [in LXX: [[Isa.48.5|Isa.48:5]], 7 (אָז), etc. ;]
long ago, of old, in time past (denoting past time absolutely, as πρότερον relatively) : [[Mat.11.21|Mat.11:21]], [[Luk.10.13|Luk.10:13]], [[Heb.1.1|Heb.1:1]], [[Jude.4|Ju 4]]; as adj., with art., [[2Pe.1.9|2Pe.1:9]] of time just past, [[Mrk.6.47|Mrk.6:47]] (WH, mg.), [[Mrk.15.44|Mrk.15:44]] (WH, mg., R, txt.); with durst. praes. (RV, all this time), [[2Co.12.19|2Co.12:19]]†
(AS)

G3850.def:
**παραβολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(παραβάλλω), [in LXX (cf. McNeile, Mt., 185): [[Num.23.7|Num.23:7]], [[Deu.28.37|Deu.28:37]], [[Psa.44.14|Psa.44:14]], [[Pro.1.6|Pro.1:6]], [[Ezk.12.22|Eze.12:22]], al. (מָשַׁל), [[Sir.47.17|Sir.47:17]] (חִידָה), al. mutt. in Sir, [[Wis.5.3|Wis.5:3]] ;]
1. a placing beside, juxtaposition (Polyb., al.).
2. a comparing, comparison (Plat., Arist., al.).
3. a comparison, illustration, analogy, figure (Arist., al.) : [[Mat.24.32|Mat.24:32]], [[Mrk.3.23|Mrk.3:23]], [[Heb.9.9; 11.19|Heb.9:9 11:19]]; specif. of the pictures and narratives drawn from nature and human life which are characteristic of the synoptic teaching of our Lord, **a parable**: [[Mat.13.3, 10|Mat.13:3, 10]] [[Mrk.4.2, 10|Mrk.4:2, 10]], [[Luk.8.4, 9-11|Luk.8:4, 9-11]], al.; with genitive ref., [[Mat.13.18, 36|Mat.13:18, 36]]
4 4 Like _Heb._ מָשַׁל ([[1Ki.10.12|1Ki.10:12]], [[Pro.1.6|Pro.1:6]], [[Sir.3.29|Sir.3:29]], al.), = παροιμία, **a proverb or gnomic saying**: [[Luk.4.23; 5.36; 6.39|Luk.4:23 5:36 6:39]]
_SYN._: παροιμία (see Abbott, _Essays_, 82 ff.) (AS)

G3845.def:
**παρα-βαίνω **
[in LXX for סוּר, עָבַר, פָּרַר, שָׂטָה, etc. ;]
1. in Hom. (twice), to go by the side of, stand beside.
2. In Æsch., Herod., Thuc., al., to go past or pass over, chiefly metaphorically, to overstep, violate, transgress ([[Jos.7.11|Jos.7:11]], [[Ezk.16.59|Eze.16:59]], [[Sir.40.14|Sir.40:14]], al.) : τ. παράδοσιν, [[Mat.15.2|Mat.15:2]] τ. ἐντολήν, [[Mat.15.3|Mat.15:3]] before ἀπό (as מִן סוּר, [[Deu.17.20|Deu.17:20]], al.), **to turn aside, fall away **(cf. π. τῆς ἀληθείας, Arist., Cael., i, 5, 2): [[Act.1.25|Act.1:25]]†
(AS)

G3862.def:
**παρά-δοσις**, -εως, ἡ
(παραδίδωμι), [in LXX: [[Est.7.26|Est.7:26]] (אֵסוּר), [[Jer.32.4|Jer.32:4]] (נָתַן ni.), [[Jer.34.2|Jer.34:2]] * ;]
1. a handing down or over, transfer, transmission (Arist., Polyb., al., LXX).
2. **tradition of doctrine **(Plat., Epict., al.); by meton., of the doctrine itself : [[Mat.15.2-3|Mat.15:2-3]], 6, [[Mrk.7.3|Mrk.7:3]], [[1Co.11.2|1Co.11:2]], [[Gal.1.14|Gal.1:14]], [[Col.2.8|Col.2:8]], [[2Th.2.15; 3.9|2Th.2:15 3:9]].†
(AS)

G3878.def:
**παρ-ακούω **
[in LXX: [[Est.3.3|Est.3:3]], 8 (עָבַר, עָשָׂה, with neg.) [[Est.4.14; 7.4|Est.4:14 7:4]] (חָרַשׁ hi.), [[Isa.65.12|Isa.65:12]] (שָׁמַע, with neg.), I [[Est.4.11|Est.4:11]], [[Tob.3.4|Tob.3:4]] * ;]
1. to overhear.
2. to hear amiss or imperfectly.
3. Later (as in LXX, Polyb., Plut.; also in π., see MM, xviii), **to hear without heeding, take no heed**: [[Mrk.5.36|Mrk.5:36]] with genitive, [[Mat.18.17|Mat.18:17]]†
(AS)

G3824.def:
**παλινγενεσία** (Rec. παλιγγ-), -ας, ἡ
(πάλιν, γενεσις),
**new birth, renewal, restoration, regeneration**;
(a) of persons (Plut., Phil., al.), of spiritual regeneration, διὰ λουτροῦ παλινγενεστίας (genitive attr., see Ellic., in l), [[Tit.3.5|Tit.3:5]]
(b) of the world, as in Stoics, Jewish Apocal., al. (see Dalman, _Words_, 177 ff.), [[Mat.19.28|Mat.19:28]]†
(AS)

G3802.def:
**παγιδεύω**
(παγίς), [in LXX: [[1Sa.28.9|1Ki.28:9]] (נָקַשׁ hith.), [[Ecc.9.12|Ecc.9:12]] (יָקֹשׁ pu.)* ;]
**to ensnare**: metaphorically, with accusative, ἐν λόγῳ, [[Mat.22.15|Mat.22:15]] (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

G3842.def:
**πάντοτε **
_adv._
of time
(πᾶς), [in LXX: [[Wis.11.21; 19.18|Wis.11:21 19:18]] * ;]
in late writers (once in Arist.) for διαπαντός, ἑκάστοτε, **at all times, always**: [[Mat.26.11|Mat.26:11]], [[Mrk.14.7|Mrk.14:7]], [[Luk.15.31|Luk.15:31]], [[Jhn.6.34|Jhn.6:34]], [[Rom.1.10|Rom.1:10]], and frequently in Paul. Epp
(AS)

G3817.def:
**παίω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָכָה hi. ;]
**to strike, smite**: with the hand or fist, [[Mat.26.68|Mat.26:68]], [[Luk.22.64|Luk.22:64]]; with a sword, [[Mrk.14.47|Mrk.14:47]], [[Jhn.18.10|Jhn.18:10]]; of a reptile, **to sting**: [[Rev.9.5|Rev.9:5]]†
(AS)

G3814.def:
**παιδίσκη**, -ης, ἡ dimin, of παῖς,
[in LXX for שִׁפְחָה, אָמָה, etc. ;]
1. a young girl, a maiden (נַעֲרָה, [[Rut.4.12|Rut.4:12]]).
2. Colloq., **a young female slave, a maid-servant **(see Kennedy, _Sources_, 40 f.; Deiss., _LAE_, 186, 332.2): [[Mat.26.69|Mat.26:69]], [[Mrk.14.66, 69|Mrk.14:66, 69]], [[Luk.12.45; 22.56|Luk.12:45 22:56]], [[Jhn.18.17|Jhn.18:17]], [[Act.12.13; 16.16|Act.12:13 16:16]]; of Hagar, [[Gal.4.22-23, 30|Gal.4:22-23, 30]]" (LXX) ; id., metaphorically, [[Gal.4.31|Gal.4:31]]†
_SYN._: see: παῖς (AS)

G3899.def:
**παρα-πορεύομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for עָבַר ;]
1. to go beside, accom­pany.
2. **to go past, pass by**: [[Mat.27.39|Mat.27:39]], [[Mrk.11.20; 15.29|Mrk.11:20 15:29]]; before διά, with genitive, [[Mrk.2.23; 9.30|Mrk.2:23 9:30]] (WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G3812.def:
**παιδιόθεν**
(παιδίον),
_adv._, [in LXX: [[Gen.47.3|Gen.47:3]] * ;]
= cl. ἐκ παιδός, παιδίον, **from childhood**: [[Mrk.9.21|Mrk.9:21]]†
(AS)

G3868.def:
**παρ-αιτέομαι**, -οῦμαι
[in LXX for בָּקַשׁ pi., etc. ;]
1. **to beg of or from another**: [[Mrk.15.6|Mrk.15:6]] (Rec. ὅνπερ ᾐτοῦντο, see Field, _Notes_, 43).
2. **to deprecate**;
(a) prop., with neg., **to entreat that not **(Thuc., al.): [[Heb.12.19|Heb.12:19]]
(b) **to refuse, decline, avoid**: o. accusative, [[1Ti.4.7; 5.11|1Ti.4:7 5:11]], [[2Ti.2.23|2Ti.2:23]], [[Tit.3.10|Tit.3:10]], [[Heb.12.25|Heb.12:25]] (EV; but see Field, _Notes_, 234).
3. to beg off, ask to be excused, excuse (Polyb., al.) : [[Luk.14.18-19|Luk.14:18-19]] ([[Heb.12.25|Heb.12:25]], Field, l.with).†
(AS)

G3877.def:
**παρ-ακολουθέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[2Ma.8.11|2Ma.8:11]] [[2Mac.9.27|2Mac 9:27]] R* ;]
with dative, to follow closely, accompany. Metaphorical, in various senses,
(a) **to result**: [[Mrk.16.17|Mrk.16:17]]
(b) **to follow up, trace, investigate**: [[Luk.1.3|Luk.1:3]] (so frequently in cl.);
(with) **to follow as a standard of conduct**: [[1Ti.4.6|1Ti.4:6]], [[2Ti.3.10|2Ti.3:10]]. (For exx. from π., see MM, xviii.)†
(AS)

G3800.def:
**ὄψώνιον**, -ου, τό
(ὀψον- see: ὀψάριον— and ὠνέομαι), [in LXX: I [[Est.4.56|Est.4:56]], [[1Ma.3.28|1Ma.3:28]] [[1Mac.14.32|1Mac 14:32]] * ;]
1. **provisions, provision-money, soldiers' pay**: [[Luk.3.14|Luk.3:14]], [[1Co.9.7|1Co.9:7]].
2. **Generally, wages, hire**: [[2Co.11.8|2Co.11:8]] ὄ. τῆς ἁμαρτίας, [[Rom.6.23|Rom.6:23]] (see Deiss, BS, 148, 266).†
(AS)

G3886.def:
**παρα-λύω **
[in LXX: [[Jer.6.24|Jer.6:24]], [[Jer.27.43|Jer 27:43]], [[Ezk.21.7|Eze.21:7]] (רָפָה), etc. ;]
1. to loose from the side, set free.
2. **to weaken, enfeeble**; pass., to be en­feebled, esp. by a paralytic stroke: [[Luk.5.18, 24|Luk.5:18, 24]], [[Act.8.7; 9.33|Act.8:7 9:33]], [[Heb.12.12|Heb.12:12]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G3861.def:
**παράδοξος**, -ον
(παρά, δόξα), [in LXX: [[Jdt.13.13|Jdth.13:13]], [[Wis.5.2; 16.17; 19.5|Wis.5:2 16:17 19:5]], [[Sir.43.25|Sir.43:25]]; 2-4 Mac 3 * ;]
**contrary to received opinion, incredible, marvellous**: pl., [[Luk.5.26|Luk.5:26]]†
_SYN._: see: δύναμις (AS)

G3882.def:
**παρ-άλιος**, -ον
(in cl., chiefly -α, -ον), [in LXX for יָם, חוֹף, etc., with prep. ;]
**by the sea**; ἡ π. (sc. χώρα, in LXX ἡ παραλία, [[Deu.1.7|Deu.1:7]], [[Jos.9.1|Jos.9:1]], [[Jdt.1.7|Jdth.1:7]], al.), **the sea coast**: [[Luk.6.17|Luk.6:17]]†
(AS)

G3871.def:
**παρα-καλύπτω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.44.8|Isa.44:8]] (פָּחַד), [[Ezk.22.26|Eze.22:26]] (עָלַם hi.)* ;]
**to cover by hanging something beside, to hide**: metaphorically (as Plat., al.), [[Luk.9.45|Luk.9:45]]†
(AS)

G3829.def:
**παν-δοχεῖον** (-δοκίον, Τ), -ου, τό
(πανδοχεύς),
late form of Att.. πανδοκεῖον,
**an inn **(khân, caravanserai): [[Luk.10.34|Luk.10:34]]†
(AS)

G3830.def:
**παν-δοχεύς**, -έως, ὁ
(πᾶς, δέχομαι),
late form of the Att.. πανδοκεύς (T, in l),
**an innkeeper, host**: [[Luk.10.35|Luk.10:35]]†
(AS)

G3869.def:
**παρα-καθίζω **
[in LXX: [[Job.2.13|Job.2:13]] (יָשַׁב)* ;]
**to set beside**; act. for mid., **to sit down beside**: [[Luk.10.39|Luk.10:39]], Rec. (for -έζομαι, which see).†
(AS)

G3833.def:
**πανοπλία**, -ας, ἡ
(πᾶς, ὅπλον) [in LXX: [[2Sa.2.21|2Ki.2:21]] (חֲלִיצָה), [[Job.39.20|Job.39:20]], [[Jdt.14.3|Jdth.14:3]], [[Wis.5.17|Wis.5:17]], [[Sir.46.6, 1-2|Sir.46:6, 1-2]]; 4Mac.6* ;]
**full armour**: [[Luk.11.22|Luk.11:22]] metaphorically (cf. Wis, l.with), τ. θεοῦ, [[Eph.6.11, 13|Eph.6:11, 13]] †
(AS)

G3822.def:
**παλαιόω**, -ῶ
(παλαιός), [in LXX chiefly for בָּלָה, pi., in pass. for בִּי qal. ;]
**to make or declare old**: [[Heb.8.13|Heb.8:13]] pass., **to become old**: of things worn out by time and use (cf. [[Jhn.9.13|Jhn.9:13]], [[Isa.50.9|Isa.50:9]], al., and see: παλαιός), [[Luk.12.33|Luk.12:33]], [[Heb.1.11|Heb.1:11]]" (LXX) ; τὸ παλαιούμενον, [[Heb.8.13|Heb.8:13]] (where this and the act., see supr., may have the sense of abrogate, see LS, Zorell, see word).†
_SYN._: γηράσκω (AS)

G3838.def:
**παντελής**, -ές
(πᾶς, τέλος), [in LXX: [[3Ma.7.16|3Ma.7:16]] A* ;]
**all-complete, entire, perfect**; εἰς τ. παντελές, **completely, utterly**: [[Luk.13.11|Luk.13:11]], [[Heb.7.25|Heb.7:25]] (where perhaps in temp. sense, finally; see MM, xviii).†
(AS)

G3834.def:
**πανουργία**, -ας, ἡ
(πανοῦργος), [in LXX: [[Jos.9.4|Jos.9:4]], [[Pro.1.4; 8.5|Pro.1:4 8:5]] (עׇרְמָה), [[Num.24.22|Num.24:22]], [[Sir.19.25; 21.22; 31.10|Sir.19:25 21:22 31:10]] ([[Sir.34.10|Sir.34:10]]) (in all cases in good or indifferent sense)* ;]
cleverness, in cl. nearly always in bad sense, **craftiness, cunning, knavery**: [[Luk.20.23|Luk.20:23]], [[1Co.3.19|1Co.3:19]] (LXX, φρόνησις, for עׇרְמָה) [[2Co.4.2; 11.3|2Co.4:2 11:3]], [[Eph.4.14|Eph.4:14]].†
(AS)

G3803.def:
**παγίς**, -ίδος, ή
(πήγνυμι), [in LXX for פַּח, מוֹקֵשׁ, רֶשֶׁת, etc. ;]
poët. (Aristoph., al.) and late for πάγη, a trap, snare; metaphorically (as also in cl.): [[Luk.21.35|Luk.21:35]], [[Rom.11.9|Rom.11:9]]" (LXX) [[1Ti.3.7; 6.9|1Ti.3:7 6:9]], [[2Ti.2.26|2Ti.2:26]].†
(AS)

G3811.def:
**παιδεύω**
(παίς), [in LXX chiefly for יָסַר ;]
1. as in cl., to train children, hence, generally, **to teach, instruct**: [[Act.7.22; 22.3|Act.7:22 22:3]], [[1Ti.1.20|1Ti.1:20]], [[Tit.2.12|Tit.2:12]].
2. As in LXX ([[Psa.6.2|Psa.6:2]], [[Pro.19.18|Pro.19:18]], [[Wis.3.5|Wis.3:5]], al., and for prob. ex. from π., see MM, xviii), **to chasten, correct, chastise**: [[Luk.23.16, 22|Luk.23:16, 22]], [[2Ti.2.25|2Ti.2:25]], [[Heb.12.7, 10|Heb.12:7, 10]]; of divine chastening, [[1Co.11.32|1Co.11:32]], [[2Co.6.9|2Co.6:9]], [[Heb.12.6|Heb.12:6]], [[Rev.3.19|Rev.3:19]].†
_SYN._: διδάσκω, q.v (AS)

G3826.def:
**πανπληθεί** (Rec. παμπλ-, see WH, _App._, 150),
_adv._ (πᾶς, πλῆθος),
= cl. παμπληθές, **with the whole multitude, all together**: [[Luk.23.18|Luk.23:18]]†
(AS)

G3857.def:
**παράδεισος**, -ου, ὁ
(an Oriental word, first used by Xen. of the parks of Persian kings and nobles) [in LXX chiefly for גַּן, [[Gen.1.8|Gen.1:8]] ff., al.; also for עֵדֶן, [[Isa.51.3|Isa.51:3]] פַּרְדֵּס, [[Neh.2.8|Neh.2:8]], [[Ecc.2.5|Ecc.2:5]] ;]
1. a park, pleasure-ground, garden (LXX), an orchard (in π., see MM, ii, xviii; Deiss., BS, 148).
2. **Paradise, the abode of the blessed dead**: [[Luk.23.43|Luk.23:43]], [[2Co.12.4|2Co.12:4]], [[Rev.2.7|Rev.2:7]].†
(AS)

G3879.def:
**παρα-κύπτω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁקַף ni., hi. ;]
1. to stoop sideways.
2. **to stoop to look**: [[Luk.24.12|Luk.24:12]] (R, txt.), [[Jhn.20.5, 11|Jhn.20:5, 11]], Metaphorical (see Hort, _Ja._, in l), **to look into**: before εἰς, [[Jas.1.25|Jas.1:25]], [[1Pe.1.12|1Pe.1:12]].†
(AS)

G3849.def:
**παρα-βιάζομαι **
[in LXX: [[Gen.19.9|Gen.19:9]], [[2Ki.2.17|4Ki.2:17]] (פָּצַר), [[Deu.1.43|Deu.1:43]] (זוּד hi.), [[1Sa.28.23|1Ki.28:23]] (פָּרַץ) see1. 4 * ;]
1. prop., to force against nature or law.
2. to compel by force (Polyb.).
3. **to constrain by entreaty **(Ge, 1Sam, ll. with): [[Luk.24.29|Luk.24:29]], [[Act.16.15|Act.16:15]].†
(AS)

G3808.def:
**παιδάριον**, -ου, τό dimin. of παῖς,
[in LXX chiefly for נַעַר ;]
a little boy, a lad (in late and colloq. Gk. the word seems to be used with greater latitude and even to lose its dimin. force entirely; cf. [[Tob.6.2-3|Tob.6:2-3]], and see MM, xviii): [[Jhn.6.9|Jhn.6:9]]†
_SYN._: see: παῖς (AS)

G3888.def:
**παρα-μυθέομαι**, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: [[2Ma.15.9|2Ma.15:9]] (Sm. 8)* ;]
1. to en­courage, exhort.
2. **to comfort, console**: with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.11.31|Jhn.11:31]], [[1Th.2.11; 5.14|1Th.2:11 5:14]]; id. before περί, [[Jhn.11.19|Jhn.11:19]]†
_SYN._: παρακαλέω (AS)

G3875.def:
**παρά-κλητος**, -ον
(παρακαλεω), [in Aq., _Th._: [[Job.16.2|Job.16:2]] * ;]
**called to one's aid in a judicial cause **(Dion. Cass.); hence, most frequently as subst., ὁ π., an advocate, pleader, intercessor (Dem., al.; so in Rabbinic lit., פְּרַקְלִיטָא), "a friend of the accused person, called to speak to his character, or otherwise enlist sympathy in his favour" (Field, _Notes_, 102). In NT, specif., ὁ π.,
(a) of Christ, [[1Jn.2.1|1Jn.2:1]] (see _ICC_, Jo. Epp., 23 ff.);
(b) of the Holy Spirit (AV, comforter; but see opp. with), [[Jhn.14.16, 26; 15.26; 16.7|Jhn.14:16, 26 15:26 16:7]] (cf. also Abbott, _Essays_, 86, 97; Deiss., _LAE_, 339 f.; MM, xviii; Westc., Jo., ii, 188)
(AS)

G3852.def:
**παρ-αγγελία**, -ας, ἡ
(παραγγέλλω),
**an instruction, charge, com­mand**: [[Act.5.28; 16.24|Act.5:28 16:24]], [[1Th.4.2|1Th.4:2]], [[1Ti.1.5; 1.18|1Ti.1:5 1:18]]. (In Xen., Polyb., of a military order.)†
(AS)

G3865.def:
**παρα-θεωρέω**, -ῶ
1. to examine side by side, compare.
2. **to over­look, neglect**: pass., [[Act.6.1|Act.6:1]]†
(AS)

G3832.def:
**πανοικεί** (Rec., LTr., -κί), adv.
(πᾶς, οἶκος), a word rejected by strict Atticists, though found once in Plat. (Eryx., 392c); [in LXX: [[Exo.1.1|Exo.1:1]] (בַּיִת), [[3Ma.3.27|3Ma.3:27]] (where A in each case reads -κίᾳ, the Attic form, cf. [[Gen.50.8|Gen.50:8]], al.)* ;]
**with all the household**: [[Act.16.34|Act.16:34]]†
(AS)

G3846.def:
**παρα-βάλλω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.2.2; 4.20; 5.1, 13; 22.17|Pro.2:2 4:20 5:1, 13 22:17]] (נָטָה hi.), [[Rut.2.16|Rut.2:16]] (שָׁלַל), [[2Ma.14.38|2Ma.14:38]] (elsewhere as seel.4)* ;]
1. to throw to or beside, as fodder to horses (Hom., al.).
2. **to lay beside, compare **(Hdt., Plat., al.): [[Mrk.4.30|Mrk.4:30]], Rec.
3. **Reflexive, to betake oneself, come near; of seamen, to cross over**: εἰς Σάμον, [[Act.20.15|Act.20:15]]
4. In mid. = παραβολεύομαι, which see†
(AS)

G3896.def:
**παρα-πλέω **
**to sail by or past**: with accusative, [[Act.20.16|Act.20:16]]†
(AS)

G3891.def:
**παρα-νομέω**, ῶ
[in LXX for הָלַל, etc., chiefly in Pss and 2Mac ;]
**to be a παράνομος, to transgress the law**: [[Act.23.3|Act.23:3]]†
(AS)

G3805.def:
**παθητός**, -ή, -όν
(πάσχω),
1. one who has suffered.
2. subject to suffering (R, mg., see M, _Pr._, 222) or destined to suffer (AV, R, txt.): [[Act.26.23|Act.26:23]]†
(AS)

G3881.def:
**παρα-λέγω **
**to lay beside**; mid.,
(a) **to lie beside **(Hom.);
(b) **later, of sailors, to sail past**: with accusative, [[Act.27.8, 13|Act.27:8, 13]].†
(AS)

G3867.def:
**παρ-αινέω**, -ω
[in LXX: [[2Ma.7.25-26|2Ma.7:25-26]], [[3Ma.5.17|3Ma.5:17]] [[3Mac.7.12|3Mac 7:12]] * ;]
to exhort, **advise**: with accusative of person(s) and inf. (see Bl., § 72, 5; M, _Pr._, 205), [[Act.27.22|Act.27:22]] absol., before λέγων, [[Act.27.9|Act.27:9]]†
(AS)

G3806.def:
**πάθος**, -ους, τό
(πάιτχω), [in LXX: [[Job.30.31|Job.30:31]] (אֵבֶל), [[Pro.25.20|Pro.25:20]], and very frequently in ([[4Ma.1.1|4Ma.1:1]] n, al.)* ;]
like πάθημα;
1. **that which befalls one, that which one suffers **
2. a passive emotion or affection (esp. of violent emotion), a passion, passionate desire; in NT always in bad sense: [[Col.3.5|Col.3:5]] π. ἀτιμίας, [[Rom.1.26|Rom.1:26]] π. ἐπιθυμίας, [[1Th.4.5|1Th.4:5]]†
_SYN._: π. = πάθημα, exc. that πάθημα is the more concrete and particular. In NT usage, π. represents the passive, ungoverned aspect of evil desire, as opposite to ἐπιθυμία, which is the active and also the more comprehensive term (see Tr., _Syn._, LXXxvii); cf. also ὄρεξις (AS)

G3810.def:
**παιδευτής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(παιδεύω), [in LXX: [[Hos.5.2|Hos.5:2]] (מוּסָר), [[Sir.37.19|Sir.37:19]], [[4Ma.5.34|4Ma.5:34]] [[4Mac.9.6|4Mac 9:6]] * ;]
1. prop., **a teacher, instructor**: [[Rom.2.20|Rom.2:20]]
2. a corrector, one who disciplines (cf. Ho, l.with) : [[Heb.12.9|Heb.12:9]]†
(AS)

G3847.def:
**παρά-βασις**, -εως, ἡ
(παραβαίνω), [in LXX: [[Psa.101.3|Psa.101:3]] (שֵׂט), [[2Ki.2.24|4Ki.2:24]] A, [[Wis.14.31|Wis.14:31]], [[2Ma.15.10|2Ma.15:10]] * ;]
1. a going aside, a deviation (Arist.).
2. In later writers, **an overstepping**; metaphorically, transgression (Plut., al.) : [[Rom.4.15; 5.14|Rom.4:15 5:14]], [[Heb.2.2; 9.15|Heb.2:2 9:15]]; τ. νόμου, [[Rom.2.23|Rom.2:23]] ἐν π., [[1Ti.2.14|1Ti.2:14]] τ. παραβάσεων χάριν, [[Gal.3.19|Gal.3:19]]
_SYN._: see: ἁμαρτία (AS)

G3848.def:
**παρα-βάτης**, -ου, ὁ
(παραβαίνω), [in Sm.: [[Psa.17.4; 139.19|Psa.17:4 139:19]], [[Jer.6.28|Jer.6:28]] * ;]
1. one who stands beside, the warrior who stands by the charioteer (of. παραβαίνω, 1).
2. **a transgressor **(Æsch., παρβάτης): [[Gal.2.18|Gal.2:18]], [[Jas.2.9|Jas.2:9]]; π. νόμου, [[Rom.2.25, 27|Rom.2:25, 27]], [[Jas.2.11|Jas.2:11]].†
(AS)

G3876.def:
**παρ-ακοή**, -ῆς, ἡ
1. **a hearing amiss **(Flat.)
2. **Later, as following inattention, disobedience**: [[Rom.5.19|Rom.5:19]], [[2Co.10.6|2Co.10:6]], [[Heb.2.2|Heb.2:2]] (cf. παρακούω, and see Tr., _Syn._, § lxvi).†
(AS)

G3804.def:
**πάθημα**, -τος, τό
(πάσχω), like πάθος,
1. **that which befalls one, a suffering, affliction**: pl., [[Rom.8.18|Rom.8:18]], [[2Co.1.6-7|2Co.1:6-7]], [[Col.1.24|Col.1:24]], [[2Ti.3.11|2Ti.3:11]], [[Heb.2.10; 10.32|Heb.2:10 10:32]], [[1Pe.5.9|1Pe.5:9]]; of Christ's sufferings: τὰ εἰς Χ., [[1Pe.1.11|1Pe.1:11]] τ. Χριστσῦ, [[1Pe.5.1|1Pe.5:1]] id. as shared by Christians, [[2Co.1.5|2Co.1:5]], [[Php.3.10|Php.3:10]], [[1Pe.4.13|1Pe.4:13]].
2. **a passive emotion, affection, passion**: [[Gal.5.24|Gal.5:24]] τ. ἀμαρτιῶν, [[Rom.7.5|Rom.7:5]]
3. **= τὸ πάσχειν, an enduring or suffering**: with genitive obj., [[Heb.2.9|Heb.2:9]]†
_SYN._: see: πάθος (AS)

G3873.def:
**παρά-κειμαι **
[in LXX: [[Jdt.3.2-3|Jdt.3.2-3]], [[Sir.30.18; 34.16|Sir.30:18 34:16]], Dan LXX [[Bel.1.14|Bel 1:14]], 2,3 Mac.5* ;]
**to lie beside, be near, be present**: [[Rom.7.18, 21|Rom.7:18, 21]].†
(AS)

G3807.def:
**παιδαγωγός**, -oῦ, ὁ
(παῖς, ἄγω),
a guide, guardian, trainer of boys, a tutor (disting. from διδάσκαλος, Xen., Lac., 3, 1), **usually a trusty slave**: opposite to πατήρ, [[1Co.4.15|1Co.4:15]] figuratively, of the Law, π. εἰς Χριστόν, [[Gal.3.24-25|Gal.3:24-25]]†
(AS)

G3815.def:
**παίζω**
(παῖς), [in LXX: [[Gen.21.9; 26.8|Gen.21:9 26:8]], [[Exo.32.6|Exo.32:6]] (צָחַק pi.); and more frequently ([[Jdg.16.25|Jdg.16:25]], al.) for (שָׂחַק pi. ;]
prop., to play as a child, hence, generally, to play (as with singing and dancing) : [[1Co.10.7|1Co.10:7]] (LXX) (cf. ἐμ-παίζω).†
(AS)

G3889.def:
**παραμυθία**, -ας, ἡ
(παραμυθέομαι) [in LXX: [[Est.8.13|Est.8:13]], [[Wis.19.12|Wis.19:12]] * ;]
1. encouragement, exhortation.
2. **comfort, consolation**: [[1Co.14.3|1Co.14:3]] .†
_SYN._: παράκλησις (AS)

G3887.def:
**παρα-μένω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.12.7|Pro.12:7]], Da TH [[Dan.11.17|Dan.11:17]] (עָמַד), etc. ;]
**to remain beside or near**: [[Heb.7.23|Heb.7:23]], [[Jas.1.25|Jas.1:25]]; of remaining alive, [[1Co.16.6|1Co.16:6]] (WH, κατα-), [[Php.1.25|Php.1:25]] (cf. συμ-παραμένω).†
(AS)

G3841.def:
**παντοκράτωρ**, -ορος, ὁ
(πᾶς, κρατέω), [in LXX: frequently in [[Job.5.8, 17|Job.5:8, 17]], al. (שַׁדַּי), and for צָבָא, in the phrase θεός (κυρίος) π., [[2Sa.5.10|2Ki.5:10]], al., and frequently in Am, Za, Ma; also in [[Wis.7.25|Wis.7:25]], [[Sir.42.17; 50.14, 17|Sir.42:17 50:14, 17]] and frequently in Jth 2, 3Mac ;]
**almighty**: [[2Co.6.18|2Co.6:18]], [[Rev.1.8; 4.8; 11.17; 15.3; 16.7, 14; 9.6, 15; 21.22|Rev.1:8 4:8 11:17 15:3 16:7, 14 9:6, 15 21:22]].†
(AS)

G3835.def:
**πανοῦργος**, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for עָרוּם ;]
**ready to do anything**;
(a) in cl., chiefly in bad sense, **knavish, crafty**: [[2Co.12.16|2Co.12:16]]
(b) in good sense, skilful, clever ([[Pro.13.1; 28.2|Pro.13:1 28:2]]).†
(AS)

G3809.def:
**παιδεία (-ία**, Τ), -ας, ἡ
(παιδεύω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּסָר ;]
1. the rearing of a child (Æsch.).
2. **training, learning, instruction **(Plat., al.): [[Eph.6.4|Eph.6:4]], [[2Ti.3.16|2Ti.3:16]].
3. As in LXX ([[Pro.3.11; 15.5|Pro.3:11 15:5]], al.), **chasten­ing, discipline**: [[Heb.12.5|Heb.12:5]] (LXX), [[Heb.12.7-8, 11|Heb.12:7-8, 11]].†
(AS)

G3823.def:
**πάλη**, -ης, ἡ
(πάλλω, to sway)
**wrestling, hence, generally, fight, contest**: figuratively, of the spiritual combat of Christians, [[Eph.6.12|Eph.6:12]]†
(AS)

G3890.def:
**παραμύθιον**, -ου, τό
(παραμυθέομαι) [in LXX: [[Wis.3.18|Wis.3:18]] * ;]
1. **an exhortation, persuasion, encouragement**: [[Php.2.1|Php.2:1]] (cf. Plat., Legg., vi, 773 E, al.; see Lft. and _ICC_, Phi., l.with).
2. assuagement, abatement, hence, consolation (Wis, l.with, and frequently in cl.).†
(AS)

G3897.def:
**παρα-πλήσιος**, -α, -ον (Hdt., Plat., al.; also -ος, -ον, Thuc., Polyb.), coming near, nearly resembling. Neut. -ον, adverbially,
**= ίως, in a way nearly resembling**: with dative, [[Php.2.27|Php.2:27]]†
(AS)

G3851.def:
**παρα-βολεύομαι**
= cl. παραβάλλομαι ([[2Ma.14.38|2Ma.14:38]]),
**to expose oneself to danger, hazard one's life**: with dative ref., τ. ψυχῇ (see M, _Pr._, 64), [[Php.2.30|Php.2:30]] (Rec. παραβουλ-). Cited by Deiss., _LAE_, 84, 120.†
**παρα-βουλεύομαι**,
to consult amiss, or perh. (see LS, see word), a vulg. form of παρα-βολ- (which see) : [[Php.2.30|Php.2:30]], Rec.†
(AS)

G3884.def:
**παρα-λογίζομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for רָמָה pi. ;]
1. to miscalculate.
2. **to reason falsely, hence, to mislead**: [[Col.2.4|Col.2:4]], [[Jas.1.22|Jas.1:22]].†
(AS)

G3859.def:
**παρα-δια-τριβή**, -ῆς, ἡ
**useless wrangling**: seel. in Rec. for διαπαρατριβή (which see), [[1Ti.6.5|1Ti.6:5]]†
δια-παρα-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ
(παρατριβή, friction, irritation)
mutual irritation (Field, _Notes_, 211), **wrangling**: [[1Ti.6.5|1Ti.6:5]] (Rec. παραδιατριβή).†
(AS)

G3866.def:
**παρα-θήκη**, -ης, ἡ
(παρατίθημι), [in LXX: [[Lev.6.2|Lev.6:2]], 4 ([[Lev.5.21, 23|Lev 5:21, 23]]) (פִּקָּדוֹן), and in [[Tob.10.13|Tob 10:13]], [[2Ma.3.10|2Ma.3:10]] [[2Mac.3.15|2Mac 3:15]], seel. for παρακαταθήκη (which see) * ;]
**a deposit or trust**: [[1Ti.6.20|1Ti.6:20]], [[2Ti.1.12; 1.14|2Ti.1:12 1:14]] (for exx. of this form, see MM, _Exp._, iii, xviii).†
(AS)

G3894.def:
**παρα-πικρασμός**, -οῦ, ἁ
(παραπικραίνω) [in LXX: [[Psa.95.8|Psa.95:8]] (מְרִיבָה elsewhere rendered Λοιδόρησις, [[Exo.17.7|Exo.17:7]] ἀντιλογία, [[Deu.33.8|Deu.33:8]], al.; λοιδορία, [[Num.20.24|Num.20:24]])* ;]
**provocation**: ἐν τῷ π. (Heb. at Meribah), [[Heb.3.8, 15|Heb.3:8, 15]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G3893.def:
**παρα-πικραίνω **
[in LXX chiefly for מָרַד qal., hi., מְרִי, most frequently in Psa and Eze ;]
**to embitter, provoke**: absol. (yet sc. τ. θεόν, cf. [[Psa.106.7|Psa.106:7]], [[Ezk.2.5-8|Eze.2:5-8]], al., and with τὸν θ. added, [[Psa.5.4|Psa.5:4]], [[Ezk.20.21|Eze.20:21]], al.), [[Heb.3.16|Heb.3:16]] (cf. παραπικρασμός).†
(AS)

G3895.def:
**παρα-πίπτω **
[in LXX: [[Ezk.14.13; 15.8; 18.24; 20.27|Eze.14:13 15:8 18:24 20:27]] (מָעַל), [[Ezk.22.4|Eze.22:4]] (אָשַׁם), [[Est.6.10|Est.6:10]] (נָפַל hi.), [[Wis.6.9; 12.2|Wis.6:9 12:2]], [[2Ma.10.4|2Ma.10:4]] A* ;]
1. most frequently (Hdt., Thuc., al.), to fall in one's way, befall.
2. to fall into or in (before εἰς, Polyb.; with dative, 2Mac, l.with).
3. to fall away (En, Wis, ll. with; in Polyb., with genitive) : absol., [[Heb.6.6|Heb.6:6]]
4. to fail (λόγος, Es, l.with; cf. [[1Sa.3.19|1Ki.3:19]]).†
(AS)

G3856.def:
**παρα-δειγματίζω**
(δείκνυμι), [in LXX: [[Num.25.4|Num.25:4]] (יָקַע hi.), [[Jer.13.22|Jer.13:22]] (חָמַס ni.), [[Ezk.28.17|Eze.28:17]] (רַאֲוָה), [[Est.4.17|Est.4:17]], Dan LXX 2:5 * ;]
**to set forth as an example; in bad sense, to put to open shame**: [[Heb.6.6|Heb.6:6]] (Polyb., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G3831.def:
**πανήγυρις**, -εως, ἡ
(πᾶς + ἄγυρας = ἀγορά), [in LXX: [[Hos.2.11|Hos.2:11]](13) 9:5, [[Ezk.46.11|Eze.46:11]] (מוֹעֵד), [[Amo.5.21|Amo.5:21]] (עֲצָרָה) * ;]
prop., a national festal assembly in honour of a god; hence, generally, **any festal assembly**: [[Heb.12.23|Heb.12:23]] (for exx. in π., see MM, xviii).†
_SYN._: ἐκκλησία (which see), συναγωγή (AS)

G3883.def:
**παρ-αλλαγή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(παραλλάσσω), [in LXX: [[2Ki.9.20|4Ki.9:20]] (שִׁגָּעוֹן)* ;]
in various senses (LS, see word), **change**: [[Jas.1.17|Jas.1:17]]†
(AS)
